Cut v0.0.1-alpha.8: the path-aggregated left-pane tree. Subjects now render as a recursive path trie — split on '/', indented by depth — replacing the fixed Section/Group/Subject model and retiring the telos|atom|bridge|tension|schema whitelist, so agents/handoff/main nests three levels. Leaves show the full path with the prefix faded and the final segment bright; branch nodes read full-weight; the [my work] and [day] section headers are colored. A dual node (subject that is also a path-prefix) appears as both a branch header and a child leaf. is_day_subject now treats the agents/handoff namespace as day vocabulary, so handoff threads sit under [day]. Reviewed by an independent Opus adversarial pass: SHIP (latent findings only, none reachable on real subject names). 56 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.8.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.9: cospan now renders day's full block vocabulary, and the project gained its first GitHub remote + CI. Two bundles shipped via PR -> green CI -> squash-merge: (#1) day-bridge and day-schema block summaries, closing the gap where alpha.7's design named day-bridge but never implemented it; (#2) robust day-witness rendering — fixes the single-probe bug that rendered {command:"cargo test"} as 'command: ?' by shape-sniffing day's overloaded fence (map vs lone probe) — plus day-docs and day-injection summaries. The cross-repo pass that drove #2 also filed the day-side format inconsistencies as kan-tools/day issues #237/#238/#239. Infra: private repo github.com/maxinelevesque/cospan with GitHub Actions (fmt+clippy+test); the kan signing seed (.kan/seed, in pre-alpha.1 history) was scrubbed with git filter-repo BEFORE the first push and verified absent from the remote — rotation was unnecessary since the repo had never been pushed. 63 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.9.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.10: the comment gutter view (P1) — telos/comment-roundtrip made visible. The comment sidecar, which already worked headless, is now a fourth TUI view (4/Tab): a picker over files that have a sidecar, and for the selected file its content with an anchored comment gutter showing each comment's live Anchored/Drifted/Unresolvable state (+confidence) as the file changes, with unresolvable comments collected in a resolve-by-hand list. Live re-localization runs via a per-file mtime gate inside the single poll tick (poll-don't-subscribe); read + re-anchor only (writes/threads/reflow/tree-sitter/session-picker deferred). Shipped as PR #3 -> green CI -> squash-merge. Independent Opus review BLOCKED a None-sentinel collision (a deleted source file left the previous file's content on screen and dropped its comments); fixed by tracking the loaded path so a missing source reads empty and its comments become Unresolvable; re-verified SHIP. Human live-TTY eyeball confirmed the render; a follow-up ordered the comment cursor by anchored line so j/k follow the file top-down. 70 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.10.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.11: comment threads + two display cleanups, shipped as PR #5 and #4 -> green CI -> squash-merge. Comment threads (#5): sidecar comments gain a reply thread and a resolve action — Comment.thread: Vec<Reply> with serde(default) for back-compat; CLI `cospan comment reply <file> <id> <body>` and `cospan comment resolve <file> <id>`; the `comments` list shows a (N replies) [resolved] suffix; the TUI Comments view strip renders the selected comment's full thread (root + attributed indented replies + [resolved]). The view stays read-only/re-anchor-only — authoring is CLI/MCP (observe-now-control-later). Cleanups (#4): short_author now head6…tail4 so signers sharing a key prefix no longer collide (and the … makes the elision honest); markdown block-HTML no longer collapses its lines onto one row. Both features: independent Opus review SHIP, human live-TTY eyeball on the threaded strip. 75 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.11.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.12: the comment view complete, banking the polish arc before the planned tabs/footer restructure. Shipped via PR #6 and #7 -> green CI -> squash-merge. #6: discoverable comment-view navigation — ←/→ switch files (aliases for [ ]), a per-view key legend in the header (· ←→ file · j/k comment), and ←/→ title hints, after a user found file-switching undiscoverable. #7: the right-anchored comment column with reflow — comments render as compact notes in a right column beside their anchored lines, and a multi-line note pushes the following code lines down (blank rows) so nothing overlaps; pure wrap_text/note_block/reflow_rows, wide-layout only, narrow keeps the single pane, the strip still holds the selected comment's full thread + unresolvable list. Both: independent Opus review SHIP, human live-TTY eyeball. Next, per user vision: a bottom footer/status-bar from `day status-line` (replacing the mis-sourced top day-status panel), then a Process tab (atoms as flowchart + telos drill-down), Ledger (renamed Browser), and Chat (live session buffers — a design discussion). 81 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.12.

Next per the vision: the Process content reshape (atoms as a drill-down flowchart, teloi as a drill-down list with statement/witnesses/tensions). 86 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Cut v0.0.1-alpha.14: the atom flowchart, shipped via PR #10 -> green CI -> squash-merge. The Process tab's atoms sub-pane is reshaped from a flat list into an ASCII box-and-arrow flowchart: each atom a labelled box laid out in columns by its longest-path depth in the atom DAG (bounded/cycle-safe layout), solid ────▶ arrows on same-row next edges, and the selected box double-bordered. j/k moves the selection; Enter drills into the atom's detail (in/out/next/done/revisits — done/revisits newly captured onto substrate::Atom), Esc returns; a pane switch leaves any drill-down. Back-flows (revisits + off-column/off-row next) are ROUTED as distinct dashed arrows (┄/┆/╰/╯/▲) in stacked lanes below the boxes in single-row layouts (the real DAG), and kept as a ⇢/↻ text list in multi-row layouts where routing would cross boxes (honest-ambiguity). Independent Opus review SHIP twice (base + routing addendum): grid math traced, no reachable panic, self-edge guarded. Human live-TTY eyeball on both. Next per vision: the telos drill-down (statement/witnesses/tensions), then Chat (live session buffers — architecture discussion). 91 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt clean. Tag v0.0.1-alpha.14.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.15: the Chat tab, shipped via PR #11 -> green CI -> squash-merge (bb6b729). A read-only cross-harness view of live agent session buffers read from the harnesses own on-disk transcripts (Claude Code JSONL, Codex rollout JSONL, opencode SQLite), scoped to the watched repo and never entering the kan fold. Per-role markdown render with per-harness prompt-tag formatting (registry + code-aware), line-scroll / message-skip / PgUp-PgDn / mouse-wheel / tail-follow navigation with a non-disruptive new-activity dot, and fold groups for back-to-back tool calls and thinking. Codex multi-agent runs split per thread: director vs subagents, guardians omitted, subagents nested collapsibly under their director in the rail. A defined-but-inert WriteChannel seam reserves the P3 control path. 123 tests, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.16: two Process/Chat refinements merged since alpha.15, each shipped via PR -> green CI -> squash-merge. (1) Telos drill-down (PR #12, bb03791): the Process tab's Telos sub-pane becomes a two-column drill-down — a selectable telos list (38%) beside the selected telos's detail (62%) showing its statement (markdown), each witness with its schema/witness probe description, and the tensions naming it with their recorded rationale; Enter/Esc move focus between list and detail, with hanging-indent wrapping. (2) Faded chat date/time labels (PR #13, 70faacd): compact dark-gray recency stamps in the Chat view — last-active per session in the rail (MM-DD HH:MM via substrate::stamp_short) and a per-message timestamp in each header (iso_short over the event ISO ts), UTC and metadata-weight. Both were verified by unit tests (cargo test 130/130), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean, real-data smokes, and the operator live-TTY eyeball rather than a fresh adversarial-review atom (the interactive renders are only verifiable in a real terminal). Tag v0.0.1-alpha.16 is annotated + SSH-signed on the release commit; main was two features past the alpha.15 tag before this cut.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.17: the comment-authoring milestone, complete through the agent-reachable MCP round trip. Two features merged since alpha.16, each via PR -> green CI -> squash-merge. (1) S4 promote-a-comment-to-a-durable-kan-claim (PR #20, 85facbf): a sidecar comment can be promoted to an immutable comment/<file> kan claim carrying the comment id; the sidecar is never mutated (re-promote appends + --cites prior), and the promoted state is read back from the in-memory fold and shown as a diamond indicator. (2) S5 the comment MCP server (PR #21, 964416b): agents read and write the comment layer over an rmcp stdio transport (cospan mcp), backed by a transport-agnostic tool core; a path-traversal guard and plugin packaging (.claude-plugin + .mcp.json + bootstrap hook) landed alongside. telos/comment-roundtrip witness is now MATERIAL. Version bump only in this commit; features shipped on their own PRs.

Cut v0.0.1-alpha.18: the comment-view vision from .dropbox/05-views-ux.md section (2), shipped in two slices each via PR -> green CI -> squash-merge. Slice A (comment-editor-layout, PR #23, ed5649a): the Comments-tab editor-view redesign -- a toggleable file tray (t), the fixed bottom strip removed with its two jobs rehomed (a pinned unresolvable band that stays visible at every width, and the full thread moved to an actionable Enter popup), a full-row comment background band, sticky scrolling for the comment cursor and the new-comment line picker, PgUp/PgDn in the picker, and a dynamically-positioned width-capped compose popup. Slice B (comment-editor-diffs, PR #24, f7edc44): live git working-tree diffs in the code pane -- a new src/diff.rs parses git diff HEAD into current-file-line-indexed added/changed/deletions, rendered as a D-toggleable sign column (+/~) with tints that yield to the comment band and a red gutter-cell highlight framing deletions, shown in all views, recomputed on the poll-and-fold mtime gate. Both slices reviewed BLOCK->fixed->SHIP by independent hostile Opus reviewers and eyeballed by the operator. telos/comment-roundtrip advanced. 192 tests, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean.
